spec_provided_observability.name: ACK / NACK
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-byte success / failure indicator on SDA's 9th SCL pulse.

spec_provided_observability.name: Arbitration Lost
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Master detects SDA actual ≠ driven; signal to higher layer that bus access was lost.

spec_provided_observability.name: Clock Stretch
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Slave-side flow control; observable as SCL held LOW after byte ACK.

spec_provided_observability.name: Bus Busy / Free
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Bus is busy after S and free a tBUF time after P.

spec_provided_observability.name: Device ID Read
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Optional 24-bit Device ID (12-bit manufacturer + 9-bit part + 3-bit revision) via Reserved Device ID address.

interrupt_sources.trigger: Master detected arbitration loss on SDA.
Receiver returned NACK when ACK expected.
Illegal condition (START or STOP at unexpected position).

interrupt_request: Interrupts are SoC-controller-specific; UM10204 lists the canonical conditions observable at the protocol layer.
notes: I2C is a wire-level spec; test/debug architecture (scan, JTAG, BIST) lives at the SoC integration level. The above are protocol-level observable conditions any compliant controller should expose.
